title: Straight Line Form

chapter_outcomes: Use the equation of a straight line
Know and use the condition for two lines to be parallel or perpendicular
Solve problems involving midpoint and length of a line, including finding and using the equation of a perpendicular bisector

Transform given relationships to and from straight-line form, including determining unknown constants by calculating the gradient or intercept of the transformed graph. For example: To straight-line form y = Axⁿ, y = Abˣ; From straight-line form to an equation of the form y² = Ax³ + B, e²ʸ = Ax² + B, y³ = A ln x + B
